app.name: Labyrinth
app.tagline: Draw a maze. Solve theirs. Fewest walls hit wins.

errors.notSignedIn: You need to sign in to do that.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.mazeIsSubmitted: This labyrinth has been submitted and can no longer be changed.

format.coordinateNotAnInteger: A coordinate must be a whole number.
format.coordinateOutOfRange: That square is outside the board.
format.gateIdNotAnInteger: A gate number must be a whole number.
format.unknownVersion: This labyrinth was saved in a format we no longer read.
format.cellCountNotAPreset: That is not one of the available sizes.

validate.duplicateCell: A square has been painted twice.
validate.boundingBoxTooLarge: The labyrinth must fit in {max} by {max} squares.
validate.disconnectedShape: Every square must join the others — no floating islands.
validate.startNotInShape: The start must sit on a painted square.
validate.treasureNotInShape: The treasure must sit on a painted square.
validate.startIsTreasure: The start and the treasure cannot share a square.
validate.keyOnStart: A key cannot sit on the start square.
validate.keyOutsideShape: The key for gate {gate} is not on a painted square.
validate.cellHoldsTwoThings: The square at {x}, {y} holds two things.
validate.segmentOutsideShape: A wall or gate at {o} {x}, {y} has nothing on one side.
validate.duplicateSegment: Two things sit on the same edge at {o} {x}, {y}.
validate.gateIdsNotContiguous: Use gates 1 to {expected}, each exactly once.
validate.gateIdReused: A gate number has been used twice.
validate.gateWithTwoKeys: Gate {gate} has more than one key.
validate.keyWithoutGate: There is a key for gate {gate}, but no such gate.
validate.treasureUnreachable: There is no route from the start to the treasure.
validate.incomplete: Place a start and a treasure to finish.
